name: Load Individuals in Reltio from Drive using Workato File Storage
description:
The recipe is used to load data for Individual entity types in Reltio. The recipes executes the data load process  using the Workato File Storage. This recipe is a long running recipe does not stop after 90 minutes. It can load data from a file upto 1 GB.
 Note there is an additional recipe required. So if you decide to use this recipe search for the dependent recipe 'Function_Load_Individuals' in the Community Library and install that too.
Key features of this recipes:
1. Process data file upto 1GB of data per job
2. Uses the File Storage that allows for large number of records to be processed. Tested with 1 million records in one file
3. The function Function_Load_Individuals performs complex transformation as well as after the batch load into Reltio tracks the failed records.
